Settings.Label: Window mode
Settings.Description: How the game fills the screen.

Settings.Label: Resolution scale
Settings.Description: Renders fewer pixels and scales up: faster, softer.

Settings.Label: Graphics quality
Settings.Description: The engine's overall scalability level.

Settings.Label: VSync
Settings.Description: Waits for the display, so the picture never tears.

Settings.Label: Frame rate cap
Settings.Description: The most frames a second the game draws.

Settings.Label: Master volume
Settings.Description: Everything the game plays.

Settings.Label: Music volume
Settings.Description: Menu and stadium music.

Settings.Label: Effects volume
Settings.Description: Hits, whistles, the crowd.

Settings.Label: Commentary volume
Settings.Description: The booth.

Settings.Label: Input buffering
Settings.Description: A move or pass pressed a moment early still happens when it can.

Settings.Label: Units
Settings.Description: How players' heights and weights are shown.

Settings.Label: Difficulty
Settings.Description: How sharp the CPU plays: how fast it reads a play, how much it adapts to your calls, how true it throws. Ratings never change.

Settings.Label: Pass lead assist
Settings.Description: Your passes lead the receiver. Off, they go where he is and the stick leads him.

Settings.Label: Auto-slide
Settings.Description: Your quarterback slides when a tackler closes on him past the line.

Settings.Label: Highlight suggested play
Settings.Description: The play your coach suggests stands out on the play-call screens.

Settings.Label: Vibration
Settings.Description: The controller rumbles on hits, catches and scores.

Settings.Label: Vibration strength
Settings.Description: How hard it rumbles.

Settings.Label: Stick dead zone
Settings.Description: How far a stick moves before it counts: smaller for a tight stick, larger for a worn one.

Settings.Label: Captions
Settings.Description: What the booth, the PA and the referees say, written at the bottom of the screen.

Settings.Label: Caption size
Settings.Description: How big captions are.

Settings.Label: Menu narration
Settings.Description: Menus say each screen and the option you move to, for a screen reader.

Settings.Label: Color vision
Settings.Description: Team and overlay colors are shifted so the ones you see alike stand apart.

Settings.Label: Reduced motion
Settings.Description: Cameras cut instead of swinging and nothing shakes the view.

Settings.Label: Camera shake
Settings.Description: How hard big hits shake the camera.

Settings.Label: Flashes and pyro
Settings.Description: How bright stadium pyro and screen flashes get.
